title: [Master]-CH] SEPA XML Files should append the Address 1 + '' + Address 2 fields under <PstlAdr><StrtNm> node if we use "Address 2" as Building Number for QR-Bills
summary: In the Swiss SEPA credit transfer XML export, the <PstlAdr><StrtNm> node now holds Address 1 and Address 2 combined when Address 2 is used as the building number for QR-Bills.
key_points: Payment Export Data (CH layer) now joins Address 1 and Address 2 into the street name node
Applies when Address 2 holds the building number, as used for QR-Bills
Tests added to the Swiss SEPA CT and SEPA CT09 export test codeunits
